fields.note: Which camp the unit belongs to. A client adds the unit to that camp where a CampMarker has placed it first, and to no camp otherwise.

fields.name: effectSide
fields.note: The side that gains what killing it grants. It applies to the camp named above, only where that camp already exists; 0 leaves the camp's value as it was.

fields.name: revealEvent
fields.note: What makes the unit known to a side that cannot see it. It applies to the camp named above, only where that camp already exists; 74 leaves the camp's value as it was.

fields.name: level
fields.note: The level it starts at.

fields.name: spawnDuration
fields.note: How long its arrival takes, in seconds.

fields.name: spawnAt
fields.note: When it arrives, in seconds of match time counted from the moment MatchStarted gives.

fields.name: behaviour
fields.note: It has no effect.

revisions.note: The monster faces from where it stands toward the facing point, or along +Z where the two are the same. Its spawnAnimation plays only where named and time is left to spawn, and it cannot be targeted while it plays. A client drops the message while its map's navigation data is unloaded. A client acts on it alike whether it arrives alone or inside EnterSight.
